description:
Framework-agnostic Java libraries for the Pathland UI protocol: a declarative
        view DSL with Angular-style signals/computed/effects, a fine-grained opcode
        emitter, the wire codec, JNA ring interop, a reusable HTML renderer, and
        cross-platform state stores. Usable from Spring Boot, Quarkus, or desktop apps.
        Runs on every LTS from Java 17.
